purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical receipt software. It reads a data-check intermediate file (DTCHK004), formats the check results into a checklist report layout (HCM401), and writes error output to an error file. It is a batch subprogram that generates a 'check list' (checklist creation) for medical data validation.
